item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 21/Mar/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A southerly airstream will bring a few showers to the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. A trough of low pressure is expected to develop over central China, and move towards the coast of southern China in the latter part of this week. The weather will become unsettled over Guangdong areas. Showers will increase and there will be squally thunderstorms. Under the influence of the associated northeast monsoon, the weather will be slightly cooler and it will still be rainy over the coastal areas early next week.
